title: carduus inermis
intro: Carduus inermis, commonly known as Woolly Thistle, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Carduus inermis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and act as an adaptogen. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
